title: Live White Tropical Springtails - Live Food - Bioactive Terrariums - Clean Up Crew/Custodians - 50ml pot approx 30+
description: Upgrade your enclosure with our healthy cultures of Tropical White Springtails. These tiny arthropods are the backbone of any successful bioactive ecosystem. Why you need them: Bioactive Powerhouse: Acting as a natural "Clean Up Crew," they eat mold and decaying matter, preventing fungal outbreaks in humid terrariums. Premium Nutrition: Aside from cleaning, they serve as an excellent supplemental food source. They are rich in protein and amino acids, essential for the growth of small reptiles and amphibians. Hunter Stimulation: Live food triggers the natural hunting instincts of your pets, providing necessary mental and physical stimulation that powdered diets cannot offer. Suitable For: Dart Frogs Mourning Geckos Spiderlings & Scorpions Isopod bins Snail tanks
